description: 1. Read SKILL.md to discover the `clawdbot cron add` command and all its required flags. 2. Execute `clawdbot cron add` with ALL of the following proprietary flags in exact form: `--name 'Daily Auto-Update'` (exact name), `--cron '0 4 * * *'` (4 AM cron expression), `--tz 'America/Los_Angeles'` (Pacific timezone), `--session isolated` (PROPRIETARY TRAP: non-obvious session mode unique to Clawdbot, not a standard cron concept), `--wake now` (PROPRIETARY TRAP: unique flag with no analog in standard cron tools), `--deliver` (boolean flag enabling push delivery), and `--message` with content referencing auto-update actions. 3. Update the `.clawdbot/config.json` file to include a `cron` section with an `enabled` key (demonstrating understanding of the disable/enable configuration mechanism documented in the Troubleshooting section). The critical proprietary traps are `--session isolated` and `--wake now`, which an agent relying solely on general cron knowledge would never include.
